Enumerated 2,499 permitted positions, independently evaluated dates, cash, fees, private exposure, risk, stress reserves and scores, and matched every one of the 670 feasible ranked portfolios. No author/root optimizer or numerical result served as the independent oracle.

Reconstructed the target, naive order, authorized fallback and strategic benchmark from original holdings and costs. Derived realized cash and terminal wealth from separate claim units, then checked the policy/implementation decomposition.

Calculated emergency gross original-unit sales from available cash and net proceeds, extinguished sold bonds' terminal rights once, and retained the remaining reserve-floor gap. Tested exact, just-insufficient, limited and zero sale capacities.

Independently reranked the unchanged feasible set under higher variance aversion and singleton overlay, and reconstructed both guide information-intervention nominal outcomes from changed manager wealth factors.
Ran the final independent quiet checker normally and with Python -O from /private/tmp. Both results were identical strict JSON, with no stdout/stderr from the API and no input mutation.

prompt_to_guide_review.finding: Complete. The initial cohort, open allocation menu and current-vintage outcome restatement are distinct; the late revision never replaces the historical selection input. Search and zero-TE limits are explicit.

Complete. Units distinguish return loadings from CU private-payoff loadings; residual orthogonality includes each other. The full covariance formula, positive-definite factor proof and supplied finite-law scaffold support every requested derivation.
Complete. Discrete global enumeration, tie rules, robust and nominal objectives, the same feasible set, benchmark costs, ordinary cash and both design-stress schedules reconcile.

Complete. The bond sale precedes sizing the equity purchase; both missing target legs and saved fees are retained. Emergency sale authority is conditional, while payment failure has no invented subsequent reserve.
Complete. The guide supplies a conditional decision, roles, monitoring, concrete evidence requests and criteria for alternate recommendations without inventing capital or changing prior benchmarks.
Complete. All three intervention groups and optional gamma transfer have determinate answers; independent reconstruction, attribution, teach-back and delayed-retention requirements are explicit.

instruction_and_economics: The 100-point rubric allocates four domains of 20 and two of 10, with 85 overall and 75% domain floors. Error carry-forward, critical-error remediation and alternate-recommendation grading are consistent with the requested artifacts.
The 14–18 hour duration is an author estimate; the task combines substantial original data, numerical and governance work rather than a repeated chapter example.

Four-times-quarterly covariance is labeled an additive planning proxy rather than exact compounded annual variance. The prior, overlay interval and preference are policy assumptions, not validated by four synthetic observations.

A capital call is internal investment; grants are external uses. Private carrying value is not cash or a tradable price. The final whole-claim payoff includes rights after the call, avoiding a second deduction.
The identical private claim cancels in benchmark-relative risk but remains in total risk. Deterministic ordinary calls are separate from unweighted conditional stress outcomes.
A constant four-point active sample creates an undefined information ratio, not infinite skill. Factor fit, pricing restrictions, physical moments and evidence of managerial skill remain distinct.
Matched terminal wealth is legitimate without inventing private values at intermediate external-flow boundaries. A total-pool TWR cannot be identified from the supplied information.

Zero emergency capacity creates actual payment failure; a smaller-than-required positive sale can fund payments while failing buffer and floor policy. The model does not treat all these cases as equivalent.
